svg.title: Disorders of growth pathway: short stature splits first on growth velocity, then on whether weight fell before height; normal velocity means familial short stature or constitutional delay (bone age on time vs delayed); weight falling first means chronic illness, undernutrition or an intrauterine cause; a short, relatively chubby child points to growth hormone deficiency or hypothyroidism; genetic causes include Turner syndrome and skeletal dysplasia; each column gives causes and clues, investigations, and treatment or outcome, with the when-to-worry criteria and work-up on top and panels on measuring and evaluating growth, other endocrine causes and other genetic syndromes
